nodes.title: Ubuntu 24.04, Wayland, electron 38.2.0 - browserWindow.showInactive()
nodes.body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

38.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu

### Operating System Version

24.04, Wayland, KDE Plasma 6

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

38.1.2

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

browserWindow.showInactive() should show app in background as inactive

### Actual Behavior

browserWindow.showInactive() just shows the window in foreground as "show()"

### Testcase Gist URL

[FIDDLE GIST](https://gist.github.com/82f73bc166be1332fb61592e093bd175)

### Additional Information

In 38.2.0 showInactive shows window as active in foreground.

```TS
const browserWindow = new BrowserWindow({
  maximizable: false,
  resizable: false,
  show: false,
  title: 'TITLE',
  width: 800,
  height: 600,
  webPreferences: {
    contextIsolation: true,
    nodeIntegration: false,
    preload: preloadScriptPath,
    sandbox: false,
    webSecurity: true
  }
})

browserWindow.showInactive()
```

This issue was extracted from https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/48429

nodes.title: Opening detached devtools on Wayland causes a crash
nodes.body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

38.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu

### Operating System Version

Ubuntu 24.04

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

38.0.0-alpha.3 (broken in 38.0.0-alpha.4)

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

Dev tools should open in it's own window when running `win.webContents.openDevTools({ mode: 'detach' })`.

### Actual Behavior

Electron running under Wayland completely crashes when `win.webContents.openDevTools({ mode: 'detach' })` is called or the dev tools are already set to open detached based on user settings. Note: it does work as expected when running under X11.

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/00417bc531b5a8f6c75af54f7ec124f1

### Additional Information

_No response_

nodes.title: Ubuntu 24.04, Wayland, electron 38.2.0 - menu not working as expected
nodes.body: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project. - [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to. - [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success. ### Electron Version 38.2.0 ### What operating system(s) are you using? Ubuntu ### Operating System Version 24.04, KDE Plasma 6 ### What arch are you using? x64 ### Last Known Working Electron version 38.1.0 ### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome? I don't know how to test ### Expected Behavior - custom menu is not shown as systemwise configured in app ### Actual Behavior - additionally the app as now a different icon per default in dev mode - menu should shown as configured on system ### Testcase Gist URL [FIDDLE GIST](https://gist.github.com/82f73bc166be1332fb61592e093bd175) ### Additional Information it works, but does not show the window as inactive. The menu + Windowbar with 38.1.x The windowbar with 38.2.0 - no menu and different icon

nodes.diff: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project. - [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to. - [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success. ### Electron Version 38.2.0 ### What operating system(s) are you using? Ubuntu ### Operating System Version 24.04 ### What arch are you using? x64 ### Last Known Working Electron version 38.1.0 ### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome? I don't know how to test ### Expected Behavior - browserWindow.on('ready-to-show') should be triggered - browserWindow.showInactive() should show app in background as inactive - custom menu is not shown as systemwise configured in app ### Actual Behavior - browserWindow.on('ready-to-show') not triggered - browserWindow.showInactive() just shows the window in foreground as "show()" - additionally the app as now a different icon per default in dev mode - menu should shown as configured on system ### Testcase Gist URL _No response_ ### Additional Information Code that works in 38.1.0: ```TS const browserWindow = new BrowserWindow({ maximizable: false, resizable: false, show: false, title, width, height, webPreferences: { additionalArguments, contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false, preload: preloadScriptPath, sandbox: false, webSecurity: true } }) browserWindow.on('ready-to-show', () => { browserWindow?.showInactive() }) ``` In 38.2.0 the "ready-to-show" event is never triggered or the callback not executed. If i change the code to: ```TS const browserWindow = new BrowserWindow({ maximizable: false, resizable: false, show: false, title, width, height, webPreferences: { additionalArguments, contextIsolation: true, nodeIntegration: false, preload: preloadScriptPath, sandbox: false, webSecurity: true } }) browserWindow?.showInactive() ``` it works, but does not show the window as inactive. The menu + Windowbar with 38.1.x The windowbar with 38.2.0 - no menu and different icon
